title: Rav Ada of Karchina
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: In Yevamot 10a he spoke before Rav Kahana in Rava’s name. In Sanhedrin 92a he raised a difficulty against Rabbi Elazar, and Rabbi Elazar answered him; Hyman calls this a scribal error and says it should read Rav Acha of Karchina, as in Dikdukei Soferim, and so it is in Berakhot 33a.

notes.text: The consulted Yevamot and Sanhedrin passages have Ada. Berakhot has Acha in the corresponding objection. The exact Dikdukei Soferim reading remains Hyman’s report.
